title: IREN (IREN) Is Up 28.7% After US$1.6 Billion Nvidia Blackwell AI Infrastructure Deal - What's Changed
title_zh: Nvidia Blackwell AI 基础设施交易完成 16 亿美元后，IREN (IREN) 上涨 28.7% - 发生了什么变化
summary: Earlier this week, IREN Limited agreed to a roughly US$1.60 billion purchase of Dell systems using Nvidia’s Blackwell GPUs for its Childress, Texas data centers, aiming to support a previously announced five‑year US$3.40 billion managed AI cloud services contract and lift proj...
summary_zh: 本周早些时候，IREN Limited 同意斥资约 16 亿美元购买使用 Nvidia Blackwell GPU 的戴尔系统，用于其位于德克萨斯州 Childress 的数据中心，旨在支持之前宣布的为期 5 年、价值 34 亿美元的托管 AI 云服务合同并提升项目。

title: Microsoft’s Defense Deal And Clean Energy Push Reframe Long-Term Valuation
title_zh: 微软的国防协议和清洁能源推动重塑长期估值
summary: Microsoft, ticker NasdaqGS:MSFT, is at the center of a new $9.7b, five year enterprise software consolidation contract with the U.S. Department of Defense.
summary_zh: 微软（股票代码 NasdaqGS：MSFT）是与美国国防部签订的一项价值 9.7 亿美元、为期五年的新企业软件整合合同的核心。

title: LG Energy Solution and DTE Sign 6-GWh Michigan Battery Storage Deal
title_zh: LG Energy Solution 与 DTE 签署 6 GWh 密歇根电池存储协议
summary: LG Energy Solution Vertech will supply DTE Energy with battery systems for eight Michigan storage projects.
summary_zh: LG Energy Solution Vertech 将为 DTE Energy 的八个密歇根储能项目提供电池系统。

title: SNOW Stock Rallies After-Hours On $6B Amazon AI Deal, Strong Earnings Beat
title_zh: SNOW 股价盘后上涨，因亚马逊人工智能交易 60 亿美元，盈利强劲
summary: Snowflake shares soared 36% after-hours on signing an AI deal with Amazon and buying Natoma, a platform for enterprise AI agents.
summary_zh: 在与亚马逊签署人工智能协议并收购企业人工智能代理平台 Natoma 后，Snowflake 股价盘后飙升 36%。

title: JPMorgan reveals spending $20 billion on an acquisition
title_zh: 摩根大通透露斥资200亿美元进行收购
summary: Jamie Dimon said JPMorgan Chase could spend up to $20 billion on a single acquisition in the coming years. He made the comments at the Bernstein Strategic Decisions Conference in New York on Wednesday, May 27.
summary_zh: 杰米·戴蒙 (Jamie Dimon) 表示，摩根大通未来几年可能会斥资高达 200 亿美元进行单次收购。他于 5 月 27 日星期三在纽约举行的伯恩斯坦战略决策会议上发表了上述言论。
